verdict.rationale: Evidence shows CLI, API, and docs for Vercel plus features letting AI agents interact with hosted apps, but nothing indicates a way to operate Vercel itself (deployments, config, dashboard) via natural-language commands or a chat/agent interface controlling the platform. missing for 10: evidence of a natural-language/chatops interface for Vercel operations, an official agent/assistant that manages deployments via NL, or docs describing such a command mode.
